body.x: iClooly(www.iclooly.co.kr) showcased 'ELITE DOCK’ for Samsung Galaxy series at '2014 International CES', the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.
This device is for Samsung Android Galaxy series as a docking station that is controllable for both PC and Smart Phones in connection with USB Mouse, Keyboard and Monitor.

'CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
